canonical_project: KAEC digital infrastructure hub: EDGNEX data center and Cinturion cable landing station
owner: EDGNEX Data Centers by DAMAC / Salam / Cinturion / Emaar The Economic City
notes: KAEC's 2023 announcement says Salam, EDGNEX, Cinturion, and Emaar The Economic City signed to make KAEC a digital infrastructure hub. DCD says EDGNEX would develop a data center and Cinturion a cable landing station outside Jeddah in KAEC. Public sources did not disclose KAEC-specific MW, separate from EDGNEX's Riyadh/Dammam capacity program.
